dissent: D7 requires the complete phase-manifest set before the first admission; this is stricter than a literal per-command reading of the design but is chosen fail-closed because the budget plan must already be complete.

D5/D6 treat the payload flag reservation_units_are_not_additive as a claim that must equal the admitted mapping (false under additive), forcing a boundary_controls source revision; an alternative reading treats it as runner-local commentary and would instead relax the contract.

D6's durable_precharge is a binding check, not a ledger write — cross-process durable writes are impossible under research_entry's write-forbidding audit hook, so durability rests entirely on the pre-dispatch nonrefundable reservation; a reviewer could demand an independent precharge ledger row, which this sandbox cannot provide.

The strict COMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE contract makes unavailable-reachable-witness outcomes campaign-fatal; admitting partial suites would require a reviewed alternative criterion that this plan deliberately does not introduce.
